leadText: Pelipper (Japanese: ペリッパ Pelipper) is a non-player character in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team, and their remake Rescue Team DX.
plainText:
Pelipper (Japanese: ペリッパ Pelipper) is a non-player character in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team, and their remake Rescue Team DX.

==In the games==
 speak to Pelipper in Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team]]
A certain Pelipper delivers mail to the 's rescue base. After the hero tells the partner that the balance of the world is in space, the partner asks Pelipper to take them into space. Pelipper tells them "no way" before flying off again. He then later leaves a letter for the hero and partner before they go on the run as fugitives to say goodbye to them. He was then happy to be delivering mail to them again once the hero and partner returned, delivering a breaking news post to Pokémon Square to tell everyone of the hero's innocence.
 
===Appearance===
 

==In animation==
 ]]
Pelipper appeared in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!. He first appeared in the beginning, flying over and of the later formed Team Go-Getters during their first meeting. He then appeared in the end, flying over to the as Team Go-Getters watched on. The Team decided to go to the Pelipper Post Office to get a new mission.
